If I left the state, I think what I'd miss most is the quiet towns I'm used to where I grew up in the northland. So, MT, WY, ID and Maybe parts of CO that aren't along the Front Range ought to scratch the outdoor itch with cold and not so much hot (plus small towns). I'd up and move with no destination in mind, no job and only enough money to Maybe get by for a month or two.... it always worked out. So my advice is to not overthink it, just go for it.
